headline: EG Q2 Deep Dive: Underwriting Discipline, Reserve Caution, and Growth in Specialty Lines
summary: Global reinsurance company Everest Group (NYSE:EG) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales falling 11.8% year on year to $3.96 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $14.85 per share was 2.2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
